'''T6H-5R''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that served [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Jorad Sindarus Thul|Jorad Thul]], a noble of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], during the [[Alderaan Civil War]].
